title: Three Days, Then a Meme
old_caption:
Three days on read, then a frog meme. The court was not amused.
A meme says hi. A reply says I saw you. Who in your chat replies in memes only?

title: Aries and Libra's anniversary.
old_caption:
One of you plans in five minutes, the other brings five options?
Aries and Libra prove fast and fair can share one anniversary.

title: Air signs, gather round.
old_caption: Air signs, your gift is words. But closeness doesn't always need them. Sometimes the most loving thing is to stop talking and just sit next to someone.
